cd /Volumes/DAL/Zettelkasten/LLMeon && shale intent "Remove 12 dangling typed edges whose targets were trashed" --body "User chose edge removal. Strip edge markup, and drop bullets whose only link is the dead target; no other prose touched" && cat > /private/tmp/claude-504/-Volumes-DAL-Zettelkasten-LLMeon/31b19934-7a88-4360-871e-70cbac1091aa/scratchpad/fix.py <<'EOF'
import re,sys
D="30_Library/"
Z=D+"100_zettelkasten/"
# (file, line no, action) action: 'drop' whole line, 'edge' strip edge only
jobs=[
(Z+"Beliefs as Defining Spaces.md",32,"edge"),
(Z+"Bottom-Up Organization Allows Emergent Structure.md",39,"drop"),
(Z+"Claim - Vocabulary acts as a compression scheme pointing to shared internal models rather than carrying inherent meaning.md",28,"drop"),
(Z+"Error Handling and Retry Pipelines for LLM Failures.md",63,"drop"),
(Z+"Externalize Memory Aggressively (cognitive offloading).md",22,"drop"),
(Z+"LLM Hallucinations Arise from Probabilistic Prediction Without External Grounding.md",45,"drop"),
(Z+"Minds Are Like Plants - Unique Products of Genes and Environment.md",26,"drop"),
(Z+"Removing a Negative Feedback Loop Can Cause Ecological Overshoot (the Kaibab Deer Case).md",40,"drop"),
(Z+"Structured Output Enforcement (JSON Schema and Function Calling).md",67,"drop"),
(Z+"The noumenal-phenomenal distinction limits knowability.md",21,"edge"),
(D+"SoT/SoT - Commitment Devices (Ulysses Pacts).md",45,"drop"),
(D+"SoT/SoT - Principles for Peaceful Productivity.md",68,"drop"),
]
dead=["Mistaking the Map for the Territory","SoT - Knowledge Architecture (Associative Ontology)","LLM Probabilistic Outputs Prevent Consistency Guarantees","Persistent Memory Layers Enable Multi-Session Agent Continuity","A Cultural Ritual Can Function as a Negative Feedback Loop Preserving Ecological Equilibrium","Use Intentional Friction to Curb Impulse Spending","The Five-Item To-Do List Reduces Overwhelm"]
for f,n,act in jobs:
    t=open(f,encoding="utf-8").read().split("\n")
    l=t[n-1]
    assert any(d in l for d in dead),(f,l)
    if act=="drop": del t[n-1]
    else:
        for d in dead:
            l=re.sub(r"\s?\[\w+:: \[\["+re.escape(d)+r"\]\][^\]]*\]","",l)
        t[n-1]=l
    open(f,"w",encoding="utf-8").write("\n".join(t))
EOF
